```{r, working with data}
#| include: TRUE
#| echo: FALSE
gender <- book$Gender

male <- 0
female <- 0
for (i in seq_along(gender)) 
{
    if (gender[i] == 0) {
       male <- male + 1
    } else {
       female <- female + 1
    }
}
cat("m: ", male, "\n")
cat("f: ", female, "\n")
print((male / female))

florence <- book$Florence
count <- 0
countandf <- 0
for (i in seq_along(florence)) 
{
    if(florence[i] == 1)
    {
        count <- count + 1
        if(gender[i] == 1)
            countandf <- countandf + 1
    }
}
cat("have bought: ", count, "\n")
cat("f: ", female, "\n")
cat("have bought and f: ", countandf, "\n")
print(countandf / female)
```

```{r, averages and median}

summary_df <- data.frame(
  group = c("Florence buyers", "Non-buyers"),
  avg_M = c(
    mean(book$M[book$Florence == 1]),
    mean(book$M[book$Florence == 0])
  ),
  med_M = c(
    median(book$M[book$Florence == 1]),
    median(book$M[book$Florence == 0])
  ),
  avg_F = c(
    mean(book$F[book$Florence == 1]),
    mean(book$F[book$Florence == 0])
  ),
  med_F = c(
    median(book$F[book$Florence == 1]),
    median(book$F[book$Florence == 0])
  ),
  avg_R = c(
    mean(book$R[book$Florence == 1]),
    mean(book$R[book$Florence == 0])
  ),
  med_R = c(
    median(book$R[book$Florence == 1]),
    median(book$R[book$Florence == 0])
  )
)

print(summary_df)

```

```{r, export plot with x: F; y: M}
#| include: TRUE
#| echo: FALSE

plot_df <- tibble(
  F = book$F,
  R = book$R,
  Flo = factor(book$Florence, levels = c(0, 1), labels = c("Non-buyer", "Florence buyer"))
)

# build summary values for the bar chart
bar_df <- tibble(
  group = factor(c("non-buyer", "buyer"), levels = c("non-buyer", "buyer")),
  avg_R = c(
    mean(book$R[book$Florence == 0]),
    mean(book$R[book$Florence == 1])
  ),
  avg_F = c(
    mean(book$F[book$Florence == 0]),
    mean(book$F[book$Florence == 1])
  )
)

# reshape for plotting
bar_long <- bar_df %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(avg_R, avg_F),
    names_to = "measure",
    values_to = "value"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    measure = factor(
      measure,
      levels = c("avg_R", "avg_F"),
      labels = c("Average recency (R)", "Average frequency (F)")
    )
  )

bar_long %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = measure, y = value, fill = group)) +
  geom_col(position = position_dodge(width = 0.8), width = 0.7) +
  geom_text(
    aes(label = round(value, 2)),
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.8),
    vjust = -0.4,
    size = 3.5
  ) +
  geom_text(
    data = bar_long %>% distinct(measure, group) %>% arrange(measure, group),
    aes(x = measure, y = 0, label = group, group = group),
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.8),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    vjust = 1.6,
    size = 3.2,
    color = "black"
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c("non-buyer" = "gray70", "buyer" = "#1f77b4"),
    labels = c("non-buyer", "buyer")
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Variables",
    y = "Value",
    fill = "Group",
    title = "Comparison of buyers and non-buyers"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    axis.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 20, hjust = 1),
    legend.position = "none"
  ) +
  coord_cartesian(clip = "off")
```
